summary.text: Mike Hite (Michael Hite) is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 92, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner who has served since December 1, 2022.

paragraphs.text: Michael Hite was born in Martinsburg, West Virginia, and his career experience includes owning a business.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
